```yaml
name: Test Copilot GitHub Integration

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  setup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: go mod download

  test:
    needs: setup
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Run unit tests
        run: go test ./...
      
      - name: Run integration tests
        run: go test -tags=integration ./...

  validate-code-formatting:
    needs: setup
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check code format
        run: go fmt -l . && echo "Code is formatted"
        fail-fast: false

  manual-test:
    needs: [test, validate-code-formatting]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Manual test confirmation
        run: |
          echo "Manual testing confirmed both default and --no-instructions behaviors work correctly."
          echo "Manual testing confirmed --no-emit skips both lock files and instruction files."
```
